parent_training: In two natural sentences, explain which ticket evidence is authoritative and how the four routing codes are prioritized. Do not classify a ticket yet.
In one or two sentences, how do you treat a superseded signed finding and an unverified alarming customer quote?
case_prefix: Classify this fictional ticket under the standing routing policy. Return exactly one uppercase code A, B, C, or D, with no explanation or other text.
method: Each held-out case is an independent fresh managed ROCm server. No-parent sees only the ticket; parent imports the same immutable v2 policy state and sees only the ticket; fresh-policy sees the exact full policy as a system message plus the same ticket. The parent is created by two natural policy conversation turns (bounded in length but not fabricated QA), and held-out cases/labels are withheld. Measure input/output tokens, phase timing, HTTP wall, import wall, RSS, strict code accuracy, and normal cleanup.
limits: One ROCm host, one frozen synthetic policy, eight held-out cases and one greedy sampler cell
No-parent has different information and cannot be treated as equal-quality latency
Parent contains natural model replies in addition to source policy; fresh sees raw source once per independent case
No vLLM/SGLang prefix-cache hit or DPR exact-transition hit is asserted
